body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Automated Experimental Result Validation System, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Range, spike, and dropout detection). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Range, spike, and dropout detection and Calibration-currency verification. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Test results comparison and reporting tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
